name: US Mechanics Lien Deadlines by State
disclaimer: This is general information, not legal advice. Lien laws change and vary by project type. Verify every deadline with a licensed construction attorney in your state before relying on it. Data current as of 2026-08-14.

Alabama: No notice required for residential; 30 days for commercial
Connecticut: No notice required for original contractors
Florida: 45 days from first furnishing (Notice to Owner)

Arizona: 120 days after completion (60 days if no NOO)
Indiana: 90 days from last furnishing (60 days for residential)
Kansas: 4 months from last furnishing (3 months for residential)
Louisiana: 60 days from last furnishing (30 days if NOO filed)
Massachusetts: 90 days from last furnishing (subcontractors: 60 days after NOF)
New Jersey: 90 days from last furnishing (120 days for residential)
Ohio: 75 days from last furnishing (60 days residential)
Texas: 15th day of 4th month from last furnishing
Utah: 180 days after completion of original contract

Texas: 1 year after filing (2 years for residential)
